package.description: Windows taskbar widget showing Claude Code usage, coloured by consumption pace.

en-US.description: Windows taskbar widget showing Claude Code usage, coloured by consumption pace.
en-US.longDescription:
A fork of CodeZeno.ClaudeCodeUsageMonitor. The taskbar widget is drawn as an
instrument panel: each usage window is a tape whose fill is what was used and
whose marker is where the clock says you should be, coloured by consumption
pace rather than raw percentage. A click opens a panel with every limit,
including the per-model weekly one, its exact reset time and a warning when
the limit would arrive before the reset at the current rate. Codex and
Antigravity usage can be shown alongside Claude Code. Thresholds and band
colours are configurable from the settings file.
en-US.name: Claude Code Usage Monitor (hadufer fork)
